meta.source: Derived from the recorded plat geometry 2026-11-05: a side yard that does not abut another platted lot is a street side.
meta.rule: interior side yard 5 ft, corner (street) side yard 15 ft, front 10 ft, rear 20 ft.
meta.validation: Checked against three surveyed Roome plot plans — 501 Callum (P-8), 500 Callum (N-5) and 560 Stark Mews (P-24). The side the survey marks 15 ft B.L. matches on all three.
meta.frame: left and right are read standing at the street looking at the lot, the same convention the fit sheet draws in.
meta.caveat: Front and rear assignment still comes from the frontage resolver and is known to be wrong on some of these lots — it labels a street rear edge ALLEY. That is a separate open defect and is not corrected by this file.
